name: Pesto Baked Salmon with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Vegetables

components.name: Pesto Salmon
steps: Pat salmon dry and lay fillets on top of vegetables. Spoon measured pesto over each piece and sprinkle chopped nuts on top.
Bake another 12-18 minutes, depending on fish thickness, until salmon reaches 63 C.
Add lemon after removing from oven; portion salmon and vegetables into four complete lunches. Chill promptly before packing.

components.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes & Vegetables

ingredients.name: Raw peeled sweet potatoes sliced thinly

steps: Preheat oven to 195 C. Arrange thin sweet potato slices on a lined tray and toss with oil and salt; roast for 20-25 minutes until nearly tender.
Scatter broccoli and tomatoes around the potatoes; roast about 8 minutes more.
